caption: The drawing depicts a single large jug or pitcher with a handle on the right side. The jug has a rounded body and a relatively narrow neck, widening slightly at the mouth. The surface of the jug is decorated with blue floral and leaf-like patterns that appear to be painted or glazed on a light grayish background. The blue designs are distributed across the entire body of the jug, with some areas showing denser decoration and others more sparsely adorned. The handle is also shaded in gray with blue accents, and the top rim of the jug is outlined in a darker blue, suggesting depth and form. The overall composition is centered on the page, with the object occupying most of the space, against a plain, off-white background. The artist's signature, "HENRY MEYERS," is visible in small letters at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Jug
